name: Shakers
author: Lyle Mills, after Perry R. Cook and Gary P. Scavone
description: Sixteen shaken and scraped instruments from Perry Cook's PhISEM, which models the statistics of colliding objects rather than any one object's shape.

controls.label: Instrument
controls.description: Steps through sixteen instruments, from a maraca through bells and gravel to a guiro.

controls.label: Shake
controls.description: How hard it is being shaken. Energy is injected continuously, so it plays without a trigger.

controls.label: Decay
controls.description: How long the instrument keeps ringing after each collision, around its measured decay.

controls.label: Objects
controls.description: How many objects are inside, from a couple of large ones to a dense hiss of small ones.

outputs.aux: The bare collision train, before any resonance.
